name: avatar-forge
description: Transcribe and rewrite reference videos, then create zeroshot talking-avatar videos with LycheeTTS.

interface.shortDescription: Rewrite reference videos and create avatar videos.
interface.longDescription: Accept an uploaded video or authorized Douyin link, extract and rewrite its spoken copy, then optionally generate LycheeTTS speech and a final zeroshot talking-avatar MP4.
defaultPrompt: 用我的人物图片、参考声音和文案生成最终 zeroshot 数字人视频。
克隆授权声音，或用 speaker_id 单独生成口播音频。
下载或上传参考视频，提取文案并改写成新口播稿。
